entities.summary: Eleanor Robson, is a British Assyriologist and academic. She is Professor of Ancient Middle Eastern History at University College London. She is a former chair of the British Institute for the Study of Iraq and a Quondam fellow of All Souls College, Oxford. She is a Fellow of the British Academy. Eleanor Robson was a architects & engineers from United Kingdom (b. 1969). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
